Centre Revises Ganga Floodplain Rules, Removes Construction Ban

The Central government has redefined the Ganga floodplain, removing a provision that designated it as a 'construction-free zone'. This revision alters the regulatory framework for development along the river. The specific details of the new flood zones and the implications of dropping the construction-free wording were highlighted in the coverage.
